macros.name: class
macros.doc: The command \class is predefined to chart appointments pertaining to class attendence.

macros.name: FiveDay
macros.doc: Tells LaTeX to typeset a five-day schedule.

macros.name: NewAppointment
macros.doc: New appointment types may be defined by the user via the \NewAppointment command.

macros.name: SevenDay
macros.doc: Tells LaTeX to typeset a seven-day schedule.

macros.name: TwelveHour
macros.doc: Tells LaTeX to typeset times using a 12-hour clock.

macros.name: TwentyFourHour
macros.doc: Tells LaTeX to typeset times using a 24-hour clock.

envs.name: schedule
envs.doc: schedule provides a simple interface for creating graphical charts displaying weekly appointments.
